journey.name: Payment Gateway Setting Change History
journey.description: Validates that administrators can inspect the chronological audit trail of gateway configuration changes filtered by country (NG) right next to the routing controls, and that saving a change immediately updates the log.

story.title: Gateway setting audit history by country

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard and navigate to '/dashboard/payment-gateways'.
Ensure the 'Country Routing & Audit Trail' tab is active and scroll to 'Gateway Setting Change History'.
Verify the audit log table lists columns: Timestamp, Actor, Action, and Details.
Verify changes show the admin email or actor, the updated enabled gateways list, and the new default gateway.
Change an enablement setting and click 'Save NG Settings'.
Verify the audit trail automatically refreshes and displays a new audit entry at the top of the table.
